{{Top|leg|title=D.Star ''Emperor's Revenge'' Site One}}
'''D.Star ''Emperor's Revenge'' Site One''' was a made-up system in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] made reference to this system in a datacard possessed by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Palme]] on [[Shintel]]. The datacard was passed onto the crew of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' in an effort to spread disinformation concerning Sarne's assets in the sector. The datacard also possessed a computer program that would trigger an overload in the engines of the ''FarStar'' when they attempted to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
